\makeatletter
\newwrite\FTentries\immediate\openout\FTentries=\jobname.entries
\newwrite\FTpieces\immediate\openout\FTpieces=\jobname.pieces
\newwrite\FTtails\immediate\openout\FTtails=\jobname.tails
\newcount\FTformatted
\let\FTformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\FTformatted by1
  \protected@write\FTentries{}{ENTRY \the\dte@tnum:#1}%
  \edef\@currentlabel{ENTRY #1}\label{FT:\the\dte@tnum:#1}%
  \FTformat{#1}}
\let\FTpiece\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{%
  \protected@write\FTpieces{}{PIECE #1;ht=\the\ht\dte@splitresult;dp=\the\dp\dte@splitresult}%
  \FTpiece{#1}}
\newcount\FTskips\let\FTskip\dte@skipcolumn
\def\dte@skipcolumn{\global\advance\FTskips by1
  \ifnum\FTskips>100\errmessage{FT no progress}\fi\FTskip}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{FT-FORMATTED \the\FTformatted}}
\makeatother
\tracingoutput=1\showboxbreadth=1000\showboxdepth=60\newmarks\FTmarks\makeatletter\let\FTrender\dte@render@tree\def\dte@render@tree{\marks\FTmarks{TREE-FIRST}\FTrender\penalty-10000 \vskip20pt \marks\FTmarks{TREE-LAST}\write\FTtails{TAIL-EFFECT}}\makeatother
